title: plank manifest
description: The manifest every plank in argo-pack ships alongside its code, as packages/<name>/plank.yaml. pack-lint validates each one against this file and additionally checks the declarations against the plank's own source.

face.description: The surface of the editor this plank presents on.

keel.description: The workspace shape this plank is built to float on. A closed set: a plank may not invent a keel, because the keel is what tells a reader which workspaces the plank's assumptions hold for.

consumes.description: Everything the plank may reach for beyond the editor, by name. A name listed here that the plank's source never references is a dead grant and pack-lint fails it.

affordance_class.description: render-only draws what it can prove. effect-surfacing draws a thing the operator may then choose to do; the doing is still theirs.

state_policy.description: A plank owns no durable state. Anything it keeps is a cache it can lose without consequence.

swap_invariant.description: Installing and then uninstalling the plank must return the workspace to where it started.

upstream.description: The editor extension points the plank actually registers against. Listing one it does not use is as much a defect as using one it did not list.

terminal.description: No plank in this pack runs a shell. There is no other permitted value, and there is no flag that changes it.
